scope.description: the finding ids this pass verifies: the ids open after the previous pass, plus any closed id whose named locations the fix pass touched again. Absent on pass 1, which verifies every id. `grade` carries a closed id's entry forward when the pass did not cover it

fix_range.description: the range the act verifier reads: the last GRADED pass's head to this pass's head. `range` is the whole round, kept for the record; handing that to the verifier made it re-read every commit of the round to grade one fix.

probe_open.description: ids the quote probe found still present in the corpus. No verifier is dispatched for them: a surviving quote is evidence the defect is there, and an id with no verdict stays open. The probe may open an id, never close one.

state_ids.description: the ids the blind state verifier judges this pass. Mid-round it is the open ids alone; on a pass that could close the round it is every id in scope, so nothing closes without two independent readings of the corpus it closes in.
